items.title: Chris Wood hikes exposure to Indian equities as AI trade falters
items.description: After a nearly 15 per cent rebound from recent lows, Indian equities, analysts believe, face a tougher test as the global backdrop turns increasingly adverse.

items.title: Nvidia stock falls 32% in Nov: Is it a buying opportunity? Analysts answer
items.description: Nvidia shares have declined nearly 32 per cent since October 29, when reports surrounding chief executive Jensen Huang first emerged. The stock traded at $213.66 on Oct 29 and at $145.98 on Nov 19

items.title: On shaky ground: These 11 Indian MFs are most exposed to US tech selloff
items.description: The tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite has declined around 9 per cent between October 1 and November 18, bringing it close to the 10 per cent threshold commonly used to define a market correction.

items.title: Arvind Fashions, Aptus, Wockhardt among Geojit's 3 stock picks
items.description: Geojit Investments' Anand James identifies three stocks, Arvind Fashions, Aptus Value Housing and Wockhardt, with buy recommendations, citing improving technical momentum and potential upside.

items.title: AI trade unwinds; India emerges as a diversification opportunity: Brokerage
items.description: Anti-AI trade should not be interpreted as a bet against technology. Rather, it represents an opportunity to invest in businesses whose earnings growth is driven by independent domestic factors.

items.title: AI sell-off hits Indian smallcaps; Sterlite, HFCL down up to 29% in a month
items.description: Analysts said that Indian companies exposed to the global AI and data-centre ecosystem are vulnerable, as valuations have already factored in strong growth expectations.

items.title: Base, precious metals meltdown; dollar dominance holds key: Julius Baer
items.description: Since we expect inflationary pressure in the US to soften, the US dollar should weaken, and investors should return to the metal markets.

items.title: Newly-listed companies add ₹32-trillion to BSE market-cap in 2026
